multilayer neural network learning dynamics under stochastic gradient descent can exhibit a mean field limit, in the sense that the behavior of the network is well approximated by a system of equations that is independent of the number and type of neurons.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the behavior of multilayer neural network under stochastic gradient descent dynamics can be captured by the dynamics of the means of the neuron activations, and that the latter dynamics is well approximated by the mean field limit of a system of coupled differential equations.
multilayer networks can be viewed as operating in an intermediate regime between the classical single neuron and mean field limits, where the number of neurons is sufficiently large but finite.
the limiting behavior of these networks can be captured by a set a few simple equations.
